strike.text: In plan view, La Espanola trends north-northwest and appears to have been traced in limited drilling along a strike length of approximately 300 m. The La Espanola Zone mineralization itself is not included

metallurgy.summary: refractory, preg-robbing, arsenic-bearing; processed by heap leach; stated recovery Au 72%, Ag 27%
